notes: Dev ABox revision carried by symmetry: borders is symmetric and Portugal has exactly one land neighbour, so making Germany its only neighbour removes the stored converse: 'Does Spain share a land border with Portugal?' goes from yes to no (related, symmetry). Derived: two compositions that follow the edit to Germany and look up an unconnected stored fact (capital, language) and a binding that reaches Portugal as Cristiano Ronaldo's home country. Germany was chosen because it does not neighbour Spain. Portugal's real neighbour Spain is a fact every model holds (an earlier South Korea edit failed because two models did not). Gaps: infini-gram was blocked on 2026-11-12 and Wikipedia answered 429, so the derived facts rest on Wikipedia searches (0 hits for two composed phrasings) and article leads; counts are listed in the build report. Related: whether the Guadiana forms part of Portugal's land border (composition, stored; the river lies on the Portugal-Spain border, which the edit removes). The earlier related question (does Spain share a land border with Portugal) was the edited pair read the other way.
